name: Alfi by Text.ai
notes: Group-chat AI that plans events, books restaurants, sets reminders, splits bills, creates images and runs games inside conversations; available as its own iOS and Android app and as Alfi Lite in iMessage, SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram. Requested via the form (issue #202).
tagline: Bringing Alfi to every group chat

access.price: App free; Alfi Lite in chat apps free up to 8 messages every 12 hours (SMS excepted); paid tier price not stated
access.regions: iMessage and SMS: US & CA; WhatsApp and Telegram: worldwide; restaurant booking US & CA
